company.description: Trippifi is a website and app which connects like-minded people who will be in the same place at the same time. We are leading the social travel revolution. Trippifi is a Dubai-based social travel networking platform that connected travelers visiting the same destinations at the same time. The platform combined social networking, destination-based communities, messaging, and local discovery features to help users make travel experiences more interactive and social. Founded in 2014, Trippifi allowed travelers to connect based on shared interests, travel dates, events, and locations, enabling them to chat, organize activities, share recommendations, and meet new people while traveling.
